name: ciwg-knowledge
description: CIWG company knowledge for Claude. Hooks fetch relevant meetings/tickets/chat/notes from the knowledge API BEFORE the model sees your prompt — no tool calls, no retrieval reasoning. Signs you in with CIWG SSO automatically on first use (browser opens once); /ciwg-login is the manual fallback. MCP tools + a company-knowledge skill for explicit deep dives, on the same sign-in.
